result.topic_en: Formula-only calculation expressing functions y and y_1 through z and its derivative with respect to q, deriving the Wronskian-type relation and the second-order linear differential equation that y and y_1 satisfy, together with the effect of a linear substitution.
result.transcription:
$\frac{1}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial q}}} = y \quad \frac{z}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial q}}} = y_1$
$y \mp cy + \partial y_1 \quad \frac{1}{\sqrt{ad-bc}}$
$y_1 \mp ay + \partial y_1 \quad \frac{1}{\sqrt{ad-bc}}$
$y\frac{\partial y_1}{\partial q} - y_1\frac{\partial y}{\partial q} = 1 \quad y_1 = zy$
$[-y-] y^2\frac{\partial z}{\partial q} = 1$
$y\frac{\partial^2 y_1}{\partial q^2} - y_1\frac{\partial^2 y}{\partial q^2} = 0$
$\frac{1}{y_1}\frac{\partial^2 y_1}{\partial q^2} = \frac{1}{y}\frac{\partial^2 y}{\partial q^2}$
[-$\frac{\partial^2 y}{\partial q^2} + p\frac{\partial y_1}{\partial q}$-]

methods.what: Definition of y and y_1 in terms of z and its derivative dz/dq (so that z = y_1/y)
methods.quote: $\frac{1}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial q}}} = y \quad \frac{z}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial q}}} = y_1$

methods.what: Linear substitution of y, y_1 normalized by the factor 1/sqrt(ad-bc)
Wronskian of y and y_1 equals 1
methods.quote: $y\frac{\partial y_1}{\partial q} - y_1\frac{\partial y}{\partial q} = 1 \quad y_1 = zy$

methods.what: Wronskian expressed through z: y^2 dz/dq = 1
Derivative of the constant Wronskian vanishes, so y and y_1 satisfy the same equation y'' = (y''/y) y
Equality of the ratios y''/y for both solutions
